## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 442 captures during January 2023. Capture activity proceeded as scheduled, with session lists operating as planned apart from routine leave. The reported activity provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures outlined below.

## Image quality

Of the 442 captures, 7 were marked ungradable by graders. This represented an ungradable rate of 1.6 per cent of all captures. The result indicates that most captured images were available for grading during the reporting month. No additional image-quality issues were recorded in the site report.

## Grading

A total of 108 results were graded referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. Grading activity therefore continued alongside routine site operations, with the reported median lag providing the summary measure for turnaround during January 2023. The referable results and ungradable images should be considered together when reviewing the month’s operational performance.
